title: Two-dimensional topological quantum chemistry and catalog of topological materials
title_zh: 二维拓扑量子化学与拓扑材料目录
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) topological materials host symmetry-protected, disorder-robust edge states central to quantum technologies. Yet they remain scarce compared with their 3D counterparts. We adapted the topological quantum chemistry formalism to layer groups and studied the band topology of 8872 entries from the computational materials databases C2DB and MC2D. We found 4073 topological or obstructed entries, including 905 topological insulators and 1003 obstructed atomic insulators, greatly expanding the library of such materials in two dimensions. Detailed electronic and topological properties of all materials have been compiled into a Topological 2D Materials Database (2D-TQCDB), and the edge states of selected new materials have been studied in detail. Our methodology has been implemented in publicly available programs, designed to study the topology of any nonmagnetic monolayer or multilayer material.
abstract_zh: 二维（2D）拓扑材料承载对称性保护、抗杂质的边缘态，是量子技术的核心。然而，与其三维对应物相比，二维拓扑材料仍然稀缺。我们将拓扑量子化学框架推广到层群，并研究了来自计算材料数据库 C2DB 和 MC2D 的 8872 条条目的能带拓扑。结果发现 4073 条条目为拓扑或受阻态，其中包括 905 条拓扑绝缘体和 1003 条受阻原子绝缘体，显著扩展了二维拓扑材料的库。所有材料的详细电子与拓扑性质已汇编成二维拓扑材料数据库（2D‑TQCDB），并对选定新材料的边缘态进行了深入研究。我们的方法已实现为公开可用的程序，旨在研究任何非磁性单层或多层材料的拓扑性。
